comparison.objective: Reinstall a dishwasher lower filter under locating tabs, then drop and quarter-turn the upper filter to lock; candidate finishes installed inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Planar insertion under tabs, coaxial bayonet alignment, drop-in seating, and detent-crossing rotation versus hammer/mandrel coordination.
comparison.success_condition: Lower filter home, upper filter at its locked stop, both still, hands clear, and nothing dropped; no fracture or loose debris.
comparison.reason: The defining mechanism is staged filter placement and bayonet locking, not sacrificial notch fracture.
